change.after: "the resources specified in a PolicyException populate matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules of the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy auto-generated from a validate.cel policy"

consequence.statement: For the same Kyverno policy and PolicyException configuration, the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy auto-generated from a validate.cel policy now excludes the resources specified in the PolicyException, so admission enforcement for those resources differs from the previous release.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, review the ValidatingAdmissionPolicies auto-generated from validate.cel policies and confirm the matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules entries match the intended PolicyExceptions.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 now applies PolicyException declarations when auto-generating Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicies from Kyverno policies that use the validate.cel subrule, populating the generated policy's matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules with the excepted resources.
